Fix tcp_rcv_synrecv_state_fastopen() to not zero retrans_stamp
if retransmits are outstanding.
tcp_fastopen_synack_timer() sets retrans_stamp
need to zero retrans_stamp here to prevent spurious
retransmits_timed_out(). The logic to zero retrans_stamp is from this
2019 commit:
commit cd736d8b67fb (""tcp: fix retrans timestamp on passive Fast Open"")
However
column2: in the corner case where the ACK of our TFO SYNACK carried

column1: some SACK blocks that caused us to enter TCP_CA_Recovery then that
non-zero retrans_stamp corresponds to the active fast recovery
need to leave retrans_stamp with its current non-zero value
correct ETIMEDOUT and undo behavior.
Fixes: cd736d8b67fb (""tcp: fix retrans timestamp on passive Fast Open"")
